import_configuration.axis: Godot X width / Y up / Z depth

instructions: A compact 24-inch-high assembly table with a thick honey-oak worktop, darker breadboard ends, four tapered square legs, a shaped front apron with one dovetailed drawer and brass cup pull, a lower cross-stretcher, and a small iron face vise. It should look lighter and lower than the elevated workbench while retaining deliberate cabinetmaker construction.
material_method: Reusable StandardMaterial3D wood, iron, steel and brass with scale-aware surface texture and separate material response; joinery and furniture construction are modeled as distinct meshes.
post_processing: import as a native Godot PackedScene
retain individually constructed mesh parts with separate wood and hardware materials
fit modeled presentation entirely within the RoomDefinition envelope
tool: Godot native furniture component authoring via RoomScale Art Factory
